subject: general
question:
Data regarding the sales of the number of shoes of sizes 7, 8 and 9 in five showrooms, A to E, is given in the following stacked bar chart. Study the chart and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c751da41c7f3d8394b6f8ee52af827223f82e9e2cc3f17d90cc8cb5ee4f238b.png] 

By approximately what percentage is the sales of shoes of size 8 more than the sales of shoes of size 9 in showroom C?
solution:
**Given:**

Sales of shoes of size 8 in showroom C = 2480

Sales of shoes of size 9 in showroom C = 740

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = [(Size 8 sales - Size 9 sales) / Size 9 sales] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage increase = [(2480 - 740) / 740] × 100

⇒ = [1740 / 740] × 100

⇒ ≈ 2.35 × 100

⇒ ≈ 235%

**∴ The sales of shoes of size 8 are approximately 235% more than the sales of shoes of size 9 in showroom C.**
